title: Drift Correction
hook: Nobody decides to get sloppy. Standards just slide a little weekly.
statement: Everything drifts. Pull it back on purpose, often.
explainer: Small fixes done often beat one giant cleanup after the collapse.
sop: Set a check Frequency. Weekly or monthly.
Pull it back. Rate Gap Closed.
equation_example: Gap Closed 6 × Frequency 4 = 24. Low means drift is outrunning your fixes.
question: Write down the day your weekly reset starts.
